rtl_result.summary: Patched the five authorized modules to fix re-arming, proper job start gating, and 1-cycle memory-latency alignment across GEMM, postprocess, and output streaming while preserving frozen interfaces and arithmetic semantics.

files.purpose: Gate job start on actual CMD handshake in IDLE; generate one-cycle phase start pulses; orchestrate loader/compute/post/out robustly across multi-job operation.
Re-armable sectioned loader with strict CMD/A/B/BIAS ordering and clean per-job counter reset on start_load.
Latency-correct sequential MAC using 1-cycle delayed memory data; emits one acc_valid per (m,n) after exact K terms.
Two-stage accept/response handling for 1-cycle bias RAM latency; no pending overwrite; one output write per acc_valid.
Read-data/valid alignment with 1-cycle output RAM latency; stable m_data under backpressure; proper final handshake done pulse.

contract_checks.requirement: Repair only authorized modules in repair_plan
contract_checks.evidence: Modified only gemm8x8x32_bias_relu_top, input_loader, gemm_core_seq, postproc_relu_bias, output_streamer; local_memories untouched.
All module port lists and top-level external signals preserved with original widths/directions.
gemm_core_seq now separates address issue and response accumulation; postproc uses pending stage for bias read; output_streamer inserts pending_data stage before asserting m_valid.
output_streamer holds m_valid and m_data while stalled; address advances only on handshake.
Top starts only on real CMD handshake in IDLE; loader counters reinitialized on each start_load pulse and returns to IDLE after load_done.
MAC uses int8*int8->int16 sign-extended to int32; accumulation and bias add are 32-bit two’s-complement wrap; ReLU uses signed MSB check after wrap.

known_risks: Top now consumes CMD beat directly in IDLE and starts loader at next cycle; behavior assumes verifier drives exact post-CMD payload sequence as specified.
Width-dependent expressions use parameter arithmetic; should be re-checked under non-default legal parameters in full regression.
